action_items: (Cleanup, low priority) Bulk SQL cleanup of leftover test rows accumulated across iterations: DELETE FROM inventory_stock WHERE product_id IN (SELECT id FROM products WHERE name LIKE 'TestInv_%' OR name LIKE 'E2E_Inv%'); DELETE FROM products WHERE name LIKE 'TestInv_%' OR name LIKE 'E2E_Inv%'; DELETE FROM product_categories WHERE name LIKE 'TestInv_Cat_%' OR name LIKE 'E2E_Cat%'. Visible noise in Productos tab UI (~10–15 TestInv_* rows from this run + previous self-test).

(Parser quirk, optional polish) CSV with trailing newline produces a phantom 'Fila N nameCampo requerido vacío' (same behavior as patients import). Consider skipping rows where ALL values are empty in _parse_csv_simple (after dict construction, drop dicts with no truthy values), to avoid showing a confusing extra error to the user. Cosmetic only; doesn't affect imports or counts of valid rows.

(Server hardening, low priority) The 5MB size enforcement uses len(raw) AFTER reading the upload — fine for our use, but for very large files behind a slow proxy you could 413 earlier via Content-Length header check (consistent with patients endpoint, not a regression).

(Optional follow-up) /api/clinic/inventory-bulk/import does not enforce a role allow-list explicitly (relies on require_clinic_member). If product creation should be admin-only, add a role check matching POST /clinic/inventory/products policy. Currently test wasn't run for doctor/receptionist on this endpoint — main agent to confirm intended permissions.
critical_code_review_comments: inventory.py bulk-import is consistent with patients pattern: separate _parse_csv_simple (encoding fallback utf-8-sig→utf-8→latin-1, delimiter sniffer) + _parse_xlsx_simple (read_only data_only) + _parse_product_row.
Dedup is robust: case-insensitive sku check first, then name|brand composite fallback. Sets are also updated INSIDE the loop preventing intra-file duplicates from sneaking through.

Auto-create categories runs once before product insert; case-insensitive lookup map (cat_by_name) is updated post-create so subsequent rows resolve correctly. Returns categories_created counter as expected.

min_stock/max_stock are explicitly cast to int via int(num(...)) — fixes the prior PostgreSQL type bug noted in agent context. inventory_stock.quantity is also cast to int(float(initial)) — correct for INTEGER column.
Stock seeding only happens for products with initial_stock > 0 — verified: row with initial_stock=0 produces no stock row and stock_seeded counter excludes it.
branch_id query param override works; falls back to is_main=true → first active branch when not provided.
5MB enforcement (HTTPException 400 with 'Archivo supera el límite de 5 MB') is now implemented (was missing in iter24/patients per its action items — good catch).
/clinic/inventory-bulk/* prefix avoids collision with /clinic/inventory/{*} dynamic routes.

(Minor) When commit_errors is non-empty (categories_create failed) the code still proceeds with product insert but blocks stock seeding (`if target_branch_id and not commit_errors`). That asymmetry could leave products without stock rows even though products got inserted. Acceptable for MVP, but consider all-or-nothing transaction semantics in the future.

(Minor) initial_stock is parsed as float via num() but cast to int when seeding. Decimal values like '5.5' will silently truncate to 5 — acceptable since column is INTEGER, but a row-level error/warning would be nicer DX.

CsvImportDialog 'inventory' entry in ENDPOINT_MAP and CATALOG_LABELS works correctly; existing /admin/catalogos and PatientsPage flows confirmed unchanged in regression (test_iter23 + test_iter24 100%).
